content.title: Bryce Harper | USA Baseball
content.text: WORLD BASEBALL CLASSICReturning to Team USA for the third time to compete in 2026 World Baseball Classic … 2012 NL Rookie of the Year … Two-time NL MVP (2015, 2021), eight-time All-Star (2012, 2013, 2015-18, 2022, 2024), four-time Silver Slugger (2015, 2021, 2023, 2024) … Posted a 5.2 bWAR season as a rookie in 2012, making first All-Star Game and winning rookie of the Year … Returned to the All-Star Game in 2013, batting .274 with 20 home runs … Named 2015 NL MVP, All-Star, and Silver Slugger after leading the NL with 42 home runs and leading the entire league in bWAR (9.7) and OPS (1.109) … Made three consecutive All-Star Games from 2016-18, hitting 87 homers and 85 doubles with an .897 OPS over that span … singed with the Philadelphia Phillies in 2019, batting .260 with 35 homers in his first season in Philadelphia … Took home second NL MVP Award in 2021 after batting .309 with 35 home runs and a league-leading 42 doubles, along with an MLB-best 1.044 OPS … Named to seventh All-Star Game in 2022 … Won third Silver Slugger Award in 2023 … Finished sixth in MVP voting in 2024, earning All-Star selection and Silver Slugger after batting .285 with 30 homers … Clubbed 27 longballs with 75 RBIs in 2025.AWARDS2x NL MVP (2015, 2021)8x All-Star (2012, 2013, 2015-18, 2022, 2024)4x Silver Slugger (2015, 2021, 2023, 2024)NL Rookie of the Year (2012)All-MLB First Team (2021)2010Bryce Harper won the 2010 Golden Spikes Award, presented to the top amateur baseball player in the United States. 2009 18U NATIONAL TEAMWon a gold medal with the 2009 18U National Team at the COPABE "AAA" Pan Am Junior Championships in Barquisimeto, Venezuela. He finished the tournament with 10 hits, and a team-leading 12 RBIs and two bombs. Team USA finished the tournament a perfect 8-0, averaging over a 10-run margin of victory.2008 16U NATIONAL TEAMWon a gold medal at the COPABE Pan Am "AA" Championships in Veracruz, Mexico with the 16U National Team. Harper led the team in eight different offensive categories: runs scored (16), hits (16), double (6), triples (1), home runs (4), RBIs (16), total bases (34), and in stolen bases (6-for-6). Team USA finished a perfect 8-0 in the tournament, defeating Mexico 7-3 in the final.
